1.text: Nuko yubura amaso abona abatunzi batura amaturo yabo, bayashyira mu isanduku y'amaturo.

2.text: Abona umupfakazi wari umukene atura amasenga abiri.

3.text: Arababwira ati “Ndababwira ukuri, yuko uriya mupfakazi atuye byinshi kuruta iby'abandi bose,

4.text: kuko bose batuye amaturo y'ibibasagutse, ariko we mu bukene bwe atuye ibyo yari atezeho amakiriro.”

5.text: Nuko bamwe bavuga iby'urusengero, uko rwarimbishijwe n'amabuye meza n'amaturo. Arababwira ati

6.text: “Ibyo mureba ibi, mu minsi izaza ntihazasigara ibuye rigeretse ku rindi ritajugunywe hasi.”

7.text: Baramubaza bati “Mwigisha, ibyo bizabaho ryari? N'ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko igihe bizasohorezwamo cyegereje ni ikihe?”

8.text: Arabasubiza ati “Mwirinde batabayobya, kuko benshi bazaza biyita izina ryanjye bati ‘Ni jye Kristo’, kandi bati ‘Igihe kiri bugufi’, ariko ntimuzabakurikire.

9.text: Ariko nimwumva intambara n'imidugararo ntimuzahagarike imitima, kuko ibyo bikwiriye kubanza kubaho, ariko imperuka ntizaherako isohora uwo mwanya.”

10.text: Arongera arababwira ati “Ishyanga rizatera irindi shyanga, n'ubwami butere ubundi bwami.

11.text: Kandi mu isi hamwe na hamwe hazaba ibishyitsi bikomeye, kandi hazabaho inzara n'ibyorezo by'indwara. Hazabaho n'ibitera ubwoba, n'ibimenyetso bikomeye biva mu ijuru.

12.text: Ariko ibyo byose bitaraza bazabafata babarenganye, babajyane mu masinagogi no mu mazu y'imbohe, babashyīre abami n'abategeka babahora izina ryanjye,

13.text: ibyo bizababeraho kugira ngo mube abahamya.

14.text: Nuko mumaramaze mu mitima yanyu, yuko mutazashaka ibyo mwireguza icyo gihe kitaragera,

15.text: kuko nzabaha ururimi n'ubwenge, ibyo abanzi banyu bose batazabasha kuvuguruza cyangwa gutsinda.

16.text: Ariko muzagambanirwa n'ababyeyi banyu, ndetse n'abavandimwe na bene wanyu n'incuti zanyu, bazicisha bamwe muri mwe.

17.text: Muzangwa na bose babahora izina ryanjye,

18.text: ariko ntimuzapfūka agasatsi na kamwe ku mitwe yanyu.

20.text: “Ariko ubwo muzabona i Yerusalemu hagoswe n'ingabo, muzamenye yuko kurimbuka kwaho kwenda gusohora.

21.text: Icyo gihe abazaba bari i Yudaya bazahungire ku misozi miremire, n'abazaba bari hagati muri Yerusalemu bazayivemo, n'abazaba bari imusozi ntibazayijyemo,

22.text: kuko iyo minsi izaba ari iyo guhoreramo ngo ibyanditswe byose bisohore.

23.text: Abazaba batwite n'abonsa muri iyo minsi bazabona ishyano, kuko hazaba kubabara kwinshi mu gihugu, kandi umujinya uzaba uri kuri ubu bwoko.

24.text: Bamwe bazicwa n'inkota, abandi bajyanwe mu mahanga yose ari imbohe, kandi i Yerusalemu hazasiribangwa n'abanyamahanga, kugeza ubwo ibihe by'abanyamahanga bizashirira.

25.text: “Kandi hazaba ibimenyetso ku zuba no ku kwezi no ku nyenyeri, kandi no hasi amahanga azababara, bumirwe bumvise inyanja n'umuraba bihōrera.

26.text: Abantu bazagushwa igihumura n'ubwoba no kwibwira ibyenda kuba mu isi, kuko imbaraga zo mu ijuru zizanyeganyega.

27.text: Ubwo ni bwo bazabona Umwana w'umuntu aje mu gicu, afite imbaraga n'ubwiza bwinshi.

28.text: Nuko ibyo nibitangira kubaho muzararame, mwubure imitwe yanyu, kuko gucungurwa kwanyu kuzaba kwenda gusohora.”

29.text: Kandi abacira umugani ati “Nimwitegereze umutini n'ibindi biti byose.

30.text: Iyo bimaze gutoha, murabireba mukamenya ubwanyu ko igihe cy'impeshyi kiri bugufi.

31.text: Nuko namwe nimubona ibyo bibaye, muzamenye yuko ubwami bw'Imana buri hafi.

32.text: “Ndababwira ukuri yuko ab'ubu bwoko batazashira na hato, kugeza aho byose bizasohorera.

33.text: Ijuru n'isi bizashira, ariko amagambo yanjye ntazashira na hato.

34.text: “Ariko mwirinde, imitima yanyu ye kuremererwa n'ivutu no gusinda n'amaganya y'iyi si, uwo munsi ukazabatungura,

35.text: kuko uzatungura abantu bose bari mu isi yose, umeze nk'umutego.

36.text: Nuko rero mujye muba maso, musenge iminsi yose kugira ngo mubone kurokoka ibyo byose byenda kubaho, no guhagarara imbere y'Umwana w'umuntu.”

37.text: Iminsi yose yirirwaga mu rusengero yigisha, ariko bwakwira agasohoka akarara ku musozi witwa Elayono.

38.text: Abantu bose bakazinduka mu gitondo, bakajya aho ari mu rusengero kumwumva.
